mapper.select: SELECT * FROM users WHERE platform = #{platform} AND platform_id = #{platformId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (username, avatar, email, phone, password_hash, bio, level, join_date, platform, platform_id, custom_tags, gender, birthday, region, preferred_language, profile_visibility, allow_comments, email_notify, site_notify) VALUES (#{username}, #{avatar}, #{email}, #{phone}, #{passwordHash}, #{bio}, #{level}, #{joinDate}, #{platform}, #{platformId}, #{customTags}, #{gender}, #{birthday}, #{region}, #{preferredLanguage}, #{profileVisibility}, #{allowComments}, #{emailNotify}, #{siteNotify})
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET password_hash = #{passwordHash}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
